basic_details.job_title: IIMK Software Developer Cum Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIMK) has announced 1 vacancy for the Software Developer Cum Operator post on a contract basis for a period of two years. The position offers a monthly pay of Rs. 35,300, and applicants must possess a B.Tech/BE/MCA/M.Sc/M.Tech or BCA/BSc/Diploma with relevant experience. Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications online through the portal by uploading the required photograph, certificates, CV, and signature. content_sections.heading: IIMK Software Developer Cum Operator at a Glance

rows.details: 30 years (as on the date of notification)
IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode 673570

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualifications and experience requirements specified for the Software Developer Cum Operator position. Relevant Experience: Proficient in deployment tools like VS Code or Netbeans Proficient in application stacks/frameworks like Laravel, CodeIgnitor, LAMP etc. Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) Knowledge of RESTful APIs and integration with third-party services Experience with JavaScript frameworks like jQuery

rows.qualification_required: B.Tech (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) / BE (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) / MCA / M.Sc / M.Tech (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or MS in Software Systems or equivalent with minimum 2 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc., OR BCA, BSc (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) / Three-year full-time Diploma (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or equivalent with minimum 3 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 35,300/-, which includes Rs. 300/- towards telephone allowance. The engagement to the position will purely be on a contract basis for a period of two years.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Work
content_sections.text: Design, develop, and maintain database-driven applications and databases; perform data entry, validation, updating, and management of institutional records; and generate reports, dashboards, and implement system enhancements as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMK Software Developer Cum Operator
content_sections.text: Visit the official portal at https://iimk.ac.in/. Submit eligible applications online latest by 5:00 pm of 25.10.2026. Upload your photograph, certificates, CV, and signature as per the format prescribed in the online portal.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible applications would be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a practical test and interview. The date of the test will be communicated by e-mail. Practical test and interview date & time will be notified later. If selected, engagement will be subject to verification of all certificates and experience at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate for the position. Candidates, who have submitted their applications, are advised to visit the website regularly for getting updates regarding the change of interview schedule, if any. Candidates are requested to check their emails regularly. Decision of the Director, IIMK regarding the selection shall be final.
